name: BACH_0321
markdown:
## Bottom line
**Suggests Benign (96%)** · Confident · Read in turn
Single-class conformal set [F1], model consensus, and clear simulated margins (≤12% risk) [F7] support routine tier-1 review.

## Confidence
| Signal | Value | Reading |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| Top probabilities | Benign 96%, Normal 2%, InSitu 2%, Invasive 0% | Strong Benign, 0% invasive |
| Conformal set | {Benign} (90% coverage, alpha 10%) | Single class at guarantee |
| Reliability / OOD | 98% reliable, 76% OOD, 12/12 regions [F6] | Typical input, no flag |
| CONCH–MUSK agreement | Same top class | Foundation models concur |
| Similar cases | 4/5 Benign (80%), 1/5 Normal [F5] | Mostly Benign; contrast Normal |

## Tissue evidence
- **Normal lobules with two-layered epithelium** (regions 0, 8, 9) · ↓ invasive · Score -0.697 [F2], but 0/20 AI check is unreliable · Unreliable
- **Benign fibrous stroma or fat** (regions 0, 3, 4) · ↓ invasive · High score (-0.656) lowers invasive risk (20/20 spot check) [F3] · Validated
- **Gland / tubule formation** (regions 3, 7, 10) · ↓ invasive · Text-only score (-0.519, caption-inconsistent) lowers risk (18/20 check) [F4] · Weak
- **Frequent mitotic figures** (region 8) · ↓ invasive · Low score (-0.672, contribution -0.413); 0/20 weak check is unreliable · Unreliable

## Trust check
- **Heatmap**: Faithful on test set (drop +0.0114, 95% CI 0.0021–0.0197); all 12 region risks here equal 0.0.
- **Concepts**: Unproven on test set (drop +0.0008, CI -0.0088–0.0064); leans on unreliable normal_lobules and mitoses (both 0/20).

## Could be wrong if
- Tissue is normal parenchyma, matching contrast BACH_0207 (Normal, 91% similarity; differs in tubules and unreliable necrosis).
- Focal atypia was missed; HoVer-Net found 0 neoplastic and 2 epithelial nuclei across regions 0, 4, 8.

## Check on the slide
1. **Regions 3, 7, 10**: Confirm benign tubules vs normal lobules; check region 3 superior-lateral margin (12% risk).
2. **Regions 0, 4, 8, 9**: Verify benign stroma; exclude pleomorphism (region 0) and invasion (region 8).
3. **Regions 5, 6**: Inspect region 5 ducts (weak score) and region 6 inflammation (unreliable necrosis).
